simple.meaning: גְּמַרְיָה (Gᵉmaryâh) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 29:3. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּמַרְיָה (H1587) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גְּמַרְיָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גְּמַרְיָה (Gᵉmaryâh) / H1587 is tracked through Jeremiah 29:3, Jeremiah 36:10, Jeremiah 36:11, Jeremiah 36:12. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

structuredEvidence.definition: Gemarjah , the name of two Israelites

evidence: Lexicon or morphology identifies this as a proper name
Occurrence trail contains male relationship language

firstOccurrence.englishText: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

timeline.evidenceText: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.
When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room: and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

definitions.short: Gemarjah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1587. Gemaryah or Gemaryahu גְּמַרְיָה גְּמַרְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath accomplished ) — 1 גמריהו son of Shaphan Jer 36:10-11 , 12 , 25 . 2 גמריה son of Hilkiah Jer 29:3 . גַּנָּה גַּן, see below גנן .
definitions.rootNote: or גְּמַרְיָהוּ ; from 1584 and 3050 ; Jah has perfected;
